title: Sync infra/github-rulesets/main-branch-protection.json with GitHub (0 approvals, no Node checks)
description:
ORG HYGIENE follow-up (thread "Org hygiene", 2026-10-17). All 20 hygiene PRs are merged.
TODO (1) as it concerns Babulus: infra/github-rulesets/main-branch-protection.json in Babulus still requires 1 approval and "Node checks"; Ryan lowered approvals to 0 and removed Node checks in GitHub. The next PR touching that file will sync the old values back to GitHub, so update the checked-in JSON to match first.

Verified 2026-10-19 on main (a64e139) and develop (identical content), infra/github-rulesets/main-branch-protection.json currently contains:
- rules[type=pull_request].parameters.required_approving_review_count: 1 (target: 0)
- rules[type=pull_request].parameters.require_code_owner_review: true
- rules[type=pull_request].parameters.require_last_push_approval: true
- rules[type=pull_request].parameters.dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push: true
- rules[type=required_status_checks].parameters.required_status_checks: [{ "context": "Node checks" }] (target: removed)
- rules[type=required_status_checks].parameters.strict_required_status_checks_policy: true
- bypass_actors: [], enforcement: active, target ref refs/heads/main, plus deletion and non_fast_forward rules.

Before editing, read the actual ruleset in GitHub (repo settings -> Rules -> Rulesets) and make the JSON match it (the other fields above may also have been changed there). This issue only tracks the sync; the JSON was NOT changed in the PR that created this issue.

Related: checking OTHER repos' checked-in rulesets and the AnthusAI org-level ruleset (org settings -> Repository -> Rulesets) is a separate follow-up, not tracked here; repo archiving was proposed but NOT approved, do not archive anything.

Source: Claude Code Projects handoff, 2026-10-19.
